cohort: 400 pregnant women (gravida 2), 200 with previous non-medically indicated cesarean delivery and 200 with previous normal vaginal deliveries.
finding: Previous cesarean delivery was associated with increased risks of impaired placental function and circulation, and adverse pregnancy outcomes, particularly in women with anteriorly located placenta near the previous uterine scar.
